matched AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.eur_amount, r.ID AS rule_id, r.fixed_amount, r.rate
  FROM tx t
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` r
    ON r.card_scheme = t.card_scheme
   AND (r.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(r.account_type) = 0 OR t.account_type IN UNNEST(r.account_type))

   AND (r.is_credit IS NULL OR r.is_credit = t.is_credit)

   AND (r.intracountry IS NULL OR r.intracountry = IF(t.issuing_country = t.acquirer_country, 1, 0))
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, eur_amount, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, MIN(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS min_fee, MAX(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS max_fee, ARRAY_AGG(rule_id ORDER BY rule_id LIMIT 5) AS rule_ids
  FROM matched GROUP BY psp_reference, eur_amount
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx) AS total_tx,
  COUNTIF(n_rules = 1) AS tx_one_rule,
  COUNTIF(n_rules > 1) AS tx_multi_rule,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx) - COUNT(*) AS tx_no_rule,
  SUM(min_fee) AS sum_min_fee,
  SUM(max_fee) AS sum_max_fee

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, card_scheme, eur_amount, is_credit, aci, issuing_country, acquirer_country
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Crossfit_Hanna' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year = 10
),
rules AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.card_scheme, t.is_credit, t.aci, t.issuing_country, t.acquirer_country, f.ID, f.fixed_amount, f.rate, f.intracountry, f.capture_delay, f.monthly_fraud_level, f.monthly_volume, f.account_type, f.merchant_category_code
  FROM tx t
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme
   AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR 7997 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = 'manual')
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
   AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = IF(t.issuing_country = t.acquirer_country, 1, 0))

WHERE psp_reference IN (SELECT psp_reference FROM rules GROUP BY psp_reference HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

),
cand AS (

    AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = m.fb)

    AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = IF(t.issuing_country = t.acquirer_country, 1, 0))
),
first_rule AS (
